events.title: Buford on the ridge
events.text: Buford's cavalry division reached Gettysburg at eleven yesterday morning, just as a detachment of Heth's Confederate division was about to enter, and deployed along the ridge east of Willoughby Run between the Mummasburg and Fairfield Roads, with pickets pushed well forward. At five this morning Heth's division leaves Cashtown, eight miles west.

sources: Terrain: USGS 3DEP elevation at 10 m, sampled to 25 m, with a modern quarry on the Baltimore Pike and Lake Heritage, a 1970s reservoir, filled. Farms, buildings, hills, the roads, the streams and the woods from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); the park avenues, the National Cemetery and the later railways are not drawn.
